# Hawthorn Builders (concept site by Kerblabs)

> Custom home builder and renovator in Needham, MA, serving Greater Boston. This is a free concept page, not the builder's own site (hawthorn-builders.com).

## Facts (from their site)
- Address: 97 Chapel Street, Suite 3, Needham, MA 02492
- Phone: 781-707-6564
- Founded: 2005 (per their FAQ)
- Services: custom homes, renovations and additions, design build, green homes (sustainable, net zero, passive), pre-construction, Home Care (subscription maintenance), luxury ADUs
- Areas: Boston, Belmont, Brookline, Cambridge, Cohasset, Lexington, Newton, Needham, Wellesley, Weston
- Booking: free discovery call, https://calendly.com/help-from-builder/general-consultation-free

## FAQ
- What does Hawthorn Builders do? Seven listed services: custom homes, renovations and additions, design build, green homes, pre-construction, Home Care and luxury ADUs.
- Where do they work? Greater Boston towns listed above.
- How do I book a first conversation? Call 781-707-6564 or use the free discovery call booking link: https://calendly.com/help-from-builder/general-consultation-free
